trigger: The parent DATA-002 matched-fill package and canonical PolyLeviathan trades lake preserve tx_hash/log_index/timestamp but project block_number away after the upstream OrderFilled decoder.

source_of_truth.transaction_mapping: Every distinct frozen 005B economic tx_hash is queried directly; returned hash must match and blockNumber must be non-null.
source_of_truth.timestamp_verification: Every distinct returned block_number is queried directly; returned block number must match and its header timestamp must equal the parent canonical row timestamp for every economic row.

hard_gates: 100% of frozen 005B economic rows map through their tx_hash to a non-null actual block_number.
100% of mapped block_numbers map to a non-null actual block-header timestamp.
Every frozen canonical timestamp equals the actual mapped block-header timestamp.
No two distinct mapped blocks share a timestamp.
No retained economic rows share the same (block_number, log_index).

ordering.acceptance_rule: The provisional corrected matrices may be accepted only if the 100% actual block-number gate passes and their sequence is proven identical to (block_number, log_index). Otherwise the provisional matrices are discarded and Stage 2 is rerun with explicit block_number.

interpretation: Recovered/corrected HOLDOUT evidence remains POST_HOC FALSIFICATION ONLY. It can demote or falsify parent findings and cannot promote or reconfirm them.
